scope: Authored usage guidance for maintained canonical demonstration members; family/dedicated contracts own component semantics and state applicability. No new behavior or verification authority.

operate: Toggle an available collection by its label or Space; toggle All collections to select the available collection inputs together.
inspect: A partial available selection makes All collections indeterminate. The archived checkbox remains checked and unavailable.
The confirmation checkbox is a separate invalid example; it is not an invalid collection item. Checking it clears the error and its description reference; unchecking restores both.
Pointer-toggle a checkbox off: its boundary remains when no focus ring is displayed. Tab to it: the visible ring replaces the boundary without resizing the mark.

operate: Tab to the delivery group and use native radio arrows or activate an available label.
inspect: Daily and Weekly are mutually exclusive; Instant remains disabled. Mixed is not a radio state.

operate: Activate a required review-route label to choose Local or Peer.
inspect: The chosen route clears its related error and removes the error description reference through the example controller. This radio-backed card does not demonstrate checkbox mixed.
Checkbox-backed cards elsewhere are separate examples, not states of this radio group.

operate: Toggle Local save confirmations using its label or Space.
inspect: The native checked value owns the track position. The managed switch remains checked and disabled.

operate: Tab to Volume and use native range arrows; use Exact volume to enter a value in steps of five between 0 and 100.
inspect: With the controller, the slider, numeric alternative, Current output and painted progress synchronize. Native slider value remains usable without that synchronization.
Inspect the managed range at 60. It is unavailable; a keyboard-focus or editing task does not apply.

operate: Edit Workspace or clear its required value.
inspect: This isolated field supports native editing/required constraints; it does not save. Save, stale status and restoring the snapshot belong to the actions specimen that includes this field.

operate: Enter or clear a record identifier in Search.
inspect: The prefix is decoration and the input owns editing/focus. This example does not execute a search.

operate: Focus and select the read-only reference text.
inspect: The reference can be inspected; editing is unavailable.
Inspect the unavailable workspace. Native editing and a normal Tab stop do not apply.

operate: Focus or edit Invalid reference to inspect its input-group geometry.
inspect: The authored invalid attribute and error are an illustration; this specimen has no numeric validation/repair controller. Editing alone must not be described as clearing its error.

operate: Enter a workspace name and activate Save; edit it again to inspect stale status; activate Restore saved value.
Clear the workspace then activate Save to inspect the local validation error.
inspect: Save updates only the local snapshot. Restore uses that snapshot, not a fixed initial value. The notification dependency controls local confirmation visibility.

operate: Activate Run local check simulation and wait for completion.
inspect: Running disables the action and sets aria-busy while status changes. Completion restores availability and reports that no external action occurred.

operate: Activate Comfortable or Compact.
inspect: The selected pressed state changes with the activated option. The example controller changes the #records-section density when present, otherwise #catalog; it does not promise that only the segment container changes. The disabled option remains unavailable.

operate: Tab to the selected tab; use Left/Right arrows or Home/End to select an available tab.
inspect: Selection moves focus and displays the associated panel. The unavailable tab is skipped.

operate: Activate Catalog or Records to follow the local destination.
inspect: These are links, not tab-selection controls. The authored aria-current marks Catalog; this fixture has no current-route updater.

operate: Activate Studio to follow the local Catalog destination.
inspect: Components is the authored current item, not another action. Inspect baseline/inline alignment separately from link activation.

operate: Choose a status; use Select visible rows; activate Name to toggle sort direction.
Choose Archived for an empty result, then All to recover.
inspect: Check actual visible rows, selected values/count and row order as well as aria markers. Filtering retains existing selections; select-visible changes only shown rows.
When columns extend beyond the view, the persistent scroll hint names the keyboard-reachable local table region; scroll to inspect every scoped column.
Inspect wrapped identity rows. This is a static list, with no list selection, sorting or filtering controller. Table data behavior must not be assigned to it.
Inspect initials and the embedded image in the same avatar geometry. These are authored illustrations, not upload or image-loading workflows.
Inspect the static Active badge. It does not change status or perform an operation.
Inspect the static notice wording and container. No save occurred in this specimen; actual local status is demonstrated with actions.
Inspect a determinate value of 40 out of 100. No import runs or increments this value.
Inspect the native indeterminate progress element with no value. This is an illustrative loading state, not running work.
Inspect the static empty-state message. Filtering and recovery controls are demonstrated in the table specimen.
Inspect the illustrative error message. There is no retry operation in this static example.
Inspect the decorative skeleton and its labelled busy wrapper. No request is running; the skeleton is hidden from the accessibility tree.
Inspect the divider between content groups. It has no interactive state.

operate: Activate a summary by pointer or by Enter/Space when focused.
inspect: Where named native-disclosure groups are supported, inspect that opening one closes the other. Record group behavior separately from summary focus and body presentation.
members.platformBoundary: These instructions describe source-declared native behavior. Observe each operation in a supported recorded browser; selector presence does not establish activation, coordination, dismissal or focus return.

operate: Activate Review preferences; close with Close or Escape.
inspect: Inspect native modal focus and focus return to the opening action. No preference changes are submitted.

optionalRuntime.purpose: Place the caret at the end of a natively focused text autofocus field; it does not open, close or choose initial dialog focus.

members.platformBoundary: These instructions describe source-declared native behavior. Observe each operation in a supported recorded browser; selector presence does not establish activation, coordination, dismissal or focus return.

operate: Focus Workspace and use the platform native selection interaction to choose Workshop.
inspect: The native value/options own selection. Locked is a disabled option, not a disabled select. Platform-popup keyboard verification is separate from slot/caret styling.
members.platformBoundary: These instructions describe source-declared native behavior. Observe each operation in a supported recorded browser; selector presence does not establish activation, coordination, dismissal or focus return.

operate: Activate Account; follow a destination or dismiss the native popover with Escape/outside activation.
inspect: Use ordinary Tab navigation for destination links. This panel is not an ARIA command menu and owns no custom arrow-key selection.
Record native dismissal and focus behavior for the supported browser; no all-browser result is attached.
members.platformBoundary: These instructions describe source-declared native behavior. Observe each operation in a supported recorded browser; selector presence does not establish activation, coordination, dismissal or focus return.

operate: Activate Team; follow a destination or dismiss the native popover with Escape/outside activation.
inspect: The paired trigger and panel use a distinct anchor. Native dismissal and trigger focus must be verified for the recorded browser.
members.platformBoundary: These instructions describe source-declared native behavior. Observe each operation in a supported recorded browser; selector presence does not establish activation, coordination, dismissal or focus return.

operate: Filter locally; Arrow keys move active descendant without changing committed value; Enter/pointer commit; Escape/blur restore; disabled options cannot commit.
inspect: Inspect inherited geometry, focus, narrow layout and no-script fallback. Single local selection; not remote search, multi-select or a command menu.

operate: Native modal focus containment and Escape/close return; destination navigation closes and focuses the destination.
inspect: Inspect inherited geometry, focus, narrow layout and no-script fallback. Modal navigation panel; not nonmodal inspector or a nested modal stack.

operate: Validate current step before advancing, preserve fields on Back, review all fields before local save; edit makes success stale.
Choose Horizontal or Vertical and Inline or Center below to compare all four renderings; Default uses horizontal centered labels and vertical inline labels.
inspect: Inspect inherited geometry, focus, narrow layout and no-script fallback. Bounded local form; not server transactions, async branching or approval authorization.
Indicator is an ol with native numbering once; current/completed/upcoming text labels agree with aria-current after Next and Back.
After Next or Back, focus lands on the new panel heading; ordinary editing and initial mount do not steal focus.
Connectors join markers in horizontal center, follow text in horizontal inline, and avoid labels in vertical center. Changing presentation preserves current stage and field values.

operate: Filter retains selection; disabled selected choices cannot be removed.
inspect: Inspect geometry, narrow layout, keyboard focus and native fallback. Async search, virtual lists and token-input combobox behavior.

operate: Focus or hover reveals; Escape dismisses; hover may enter the tooltip.
inspect: Inspect geometry, narrow layout, keyboard focus and native fallback. Interactive content, essential instructions available only on hover, or touch-only discovery.

operate: Maximum three persistent local notifications; dismiss returns focus to adjacent notification or trigger.
inspect: Inspect geometry, narrow layout, keyboard focus and native fallback. Auto-expiry, cross-page delivery, server messages or emergency alerts.

operate: Three records per page; filter resets page; empty results announced; buttons preserve focus.
inspect: Inspect geometry, narrow layout, keyboard focus and native fallback. Remote pagination, URL routing or virtualized datasets.

operate: Arrows traverse/expand/collapse; Home/End, typeahead, sibling expansion and Enter selection.
inspect: Inspect geometry, narrow layout, keyboard focus and native fallback. Lazy loading, drag-and-drop, multiselection or route navigation.

operate: Arrows and week edges move days; PageUp/Down changes month, Shift changes year; selection commits, Escape cancels.
inspect: Inspect geometry, narrow layout, keyboard focus and native fallback. Range selection, time zones, non-Gregorian calendars or missing min/max bounds.

operate: Roving cell focus; Enter/F2 edits; Enter commits valid data, Escape cancels; Tab commits then moves cell.
inspect: Inspect geometry, narrow layout, keyboard focus and native fallback. Spreadsheet formulas, dynamic columns, sorting, virtualization or multi-cell selection.

operate: Select text then apply bold, italic or plain text; paste inserts text only; local save exposes restricted semantic HTML.
inspect: Inspect geometry, narrow layout, keyboard focus and native fallback. Full document editing, links, images, lists, collaborative editing or guaranteed undo history.

operate: Activate a claim by click, Enter or Space, then move focus away.
inspect: One claim remains pressed, its adjacent detail updates, and selected rest paint includes an underline in both schemes.

operate: Select Research workspace, then toggle Prefer Design studio by its label and Space.
inspect: The checkbox does not change the selected workspace; Design studio options remain within its own choice container. Primary radio alone controls selected container paint.

operate: Select the second incident with Enter, inspect Evidence and the bounded plan, then resolve it.
At narrow width, scroll the named queue region to inspect priority and owner.
inspect: Incident identity and status share the first column; long titles wrap, short words remain whole.
Detail, evidence, plan and Resolve share one task group in DOM and visual order. Queue and detail align at their start rather than stretching to equal height.
Selection updates detail and pressed state together; resolving updates the selected row status and disables repeat resolution.

limits: Do not apply the family state union to each member. Native impossibilities and host-dependent behaviors remain explicitly unavailable or conditional.
An owner-state result does not verify reflected wrapper/subpart presentation.
Instructions must match extracted controls and exact controller/DOM peers; missing peers make the demonstration incomplete, not a new capability.
dependencyIdentity: Keyed hashes are the prepared integration snapshot; validate or regenerate these bindings whenever an input changes. Compiled external evidence must bind the current guide and dependency hashes.
